construction.stretch: Sarthana to Dream City via Majura Gate and Surat Railway Station
construction.notes: 15.14 km elevated and 6.47 km underground. Key stations include Sarthana, Nature Park, Varachha, Kapodra, Surat Railway Station, Chowk Bazar, Majura Gate (interchange), VIP Road, Dream City.

source.title: Surat Metro Phase 1 Corridor 1 Project Profile

lines.notes: Corridor 1 (Diamond Corridor) spans 21.61 km with 21 stations connecting Sarthana to Dream City. Under active construction across civil packages CS-01 through CS-06.

construction.stretch: Bhesan to Saroli via Majura Gate and Athwa Chopati
construction.notes: 18.74 km fully elevated corridor with 18 stations. Key stations include Bhesan, Botanical Garden, Palanpur Road, Adajan Gam, Athwa Chopati, Majura Gate (interchange), Udhna Darwaja, Saroli.

source.title: Surat Metro Phase 1 Corridor 2 Project Profile

lines.notes: Corridor 2 (Textile Corridor) spans 18.74 km entirely elevated with 18 stations connecting Bhesan to Saroli, intersecting Corridor 1 at Majura Gate.
